trajectory_summary: This is a short reschedule call, not a full setter call — the customer was already primed from a prior design, so most script sections were legitimately skipped. The energy is mostly stagnant/mixed: cooperative throughout, but the scheduling logistics dragged because the rep offered loose windows instead of anchoring, and the customer ended up doing the narrowing work himself.
outcome_dispute: This should be read as booked, not tentative — a specific day (Wednesday) and time (5PM) were mutually agreed at 02:19–02:26. However button_up was only partially completed (no hour-block statement, no 'is that fair' handshake, no explicit spouse confirmation beyond the customer's own assertion), so it is a fragile booked outcome.

observed_outcome.quote: Just do 05:00 on Wednesday. There's nothing on her schedule, and I don't have anything on mine.
observed_outcome.reasoning: A specific day (Wednesday) and time (5PM) were mutually confirmed by both parties at 02:19-02:26, meeting the bar for booked. The customer references his wife's ('her') schedule but the rep never directly confirms she will be present, so co_owner_confirmed is false rather than null since a co-decider was clearly identified in conversation.
observed_outcome.set_rule: booked by time, tentative by rule: bill not_asked
